I have just been sent someone else's personal data by mistake and need to know what to do with it. The file has names and home addresses for dozens of people who are not me. Please escalate this immediately -- every minute it continues makes it worse.

Thank you for your help,
Anja Haddad

tickets.subject: Locked out after too many attempts
tickets.body:
Hi,

Too many wrong password attempts have locked me out and I cannot get back in. The unlock link in your email takes me back to the same locked screen.

I need this resolved today; tomorrow is already too late for me.

Thank you for your help,
Sinead Novak

tickets.subject: Billing address change for future invoices
tickets.body:
Hello support team,

Please change the billing address on our invoices to our new office. Invoice INV-32634 still shows the previous office, and we would like our cost centre code shown as well. Next week would be completely fine for a reply.

Kind regards,
Owen Tanaka

tickets.subject: Order form needed today for procurement
tickets.body:
Hi there,

Our procurement team needs the countersigned order form from you today to release the purchase order. Everything in the quote for 49 seats is agreed internally and only your signature is outstanding.

I need this resolved today; tomorrow is already too late for me.

Grateful for any help you can give,
Elif Alvarez

tickets.subject: Status of my application for the support specialist position
tickets.body:
Hi there,

Three weeks after applying for the support specialist job I still have no news, so I wanted to ask whether my application is still being considered. The reference I was given is REF-GP64C and the date was 20 July. This is not blocking me today, but I would like it sorted this week.

Thank you for your help,
Noah Iqbal

tickets.subject: Checking a figure before we publish
tickets.body:
Hello,

I am fact-checking a figure for a piece in Foundry Quarterly that files to my editor at the end of the day and I need it confirmed before then. The number in question is $3,725.75, from a source I would like you to confirm.

Please treat this as same-day: I cannot carry on until it is done.

Kind regards,
Kofi Novak

tickets.subject: Formal data request under data protection law
tickets.body:
Hello,

Under data protection law I am asking for a copy of all personal data you hold on me. I understand you have a month to answer; I would just like to know it has arrived. A reply within a couple of working days would be ideal.

Thank you for your help,
Nora Novak

tickets.subject: Small display bug on the reports screen
tickets.body:
Dear support team,

I wanted to report a cosmetic bug -- the labels on the dashboard charts sit on top of one another at narrow widths. There is no error message and the underlying figures are correct.

This is not blocking anything, so whenever someone has time is fine.

Thanks in advance,
Anders Okafor

tickets.subject: Change to our delivery instructions
tickets.body:
Hello,

Please update the delivery instructions so parcels are handed in at reception instead of left at the loading bay. Nothing is missing from ORD-522275; it is only the drop-off point I would like changed. I am only asking so I can plan ahead, so please take your time.

Thank you for your help,
Rukmini Moreau

tickets.subject: Interview tomorrow -- can we reschedule?
tickets.body:
Hi there,

Tomorrow's interview clashes with something I cannot move; can recruiting rebook it and confirm today? Any slot later in the week works for me; the reference is REF-QHFEC. I am blocked until this is sorted and I need it resolved today.

Thank you for your help,
Hiroshi Bauer

tickets.subject: Charged three times for invoice INV-41083
tickets.body:
Dear support team,

The card has been charged $173.69 three times for invoice INV-41083 and a fourth payment attempt is pending. The duplicated payments have left us short for payroll this week. I am asking for immediate help: the situation is live and still running.

Grateful for any help you can give,
Sinead Osei

tickets.subject: Publishing in two hours, statement needed
tickets.body:
Hello support team,

The story runs in two hours and I have to carry either your statement or a line saying you declined. The piece names your company, so I would rather have your words in it than a note that you did not reply.

We need someone on this within the hour; it is an emergency at our end.

Thank you for your help,
Sinead Silva

tickets.subject: Written quote needed for procurement
tickets.body:
Hi,

Could you send a written quote for 97 seats? Our procurement team needs it on paper before they will raise anything. We have never bought from you before, so there is nothing on record at your end. Normal turnaround is fine, as long as it is dealt with this week.

Many thanks,
Anja Jansen

tickets.subject: Shipment appears stuck in transit
tickets.body:
Hi there,

Tracking on ORD-670043 has been stuck at the same depot since 9 March; please find out what has happened to the parcel. The last scan was at the Bristol depot and there has been no movement at all. Normal turnaround is fine, as long as it is dealt with this week.

Kind regards,
Noah Halloran

tickets.subject: Erasure request deadline is tomorrow morning
tickets.body:
Hello,

The erasure request I made under data protection law is nearly out of time; the deadline is tomorrow morning. I still have the acknowledgement you sent on 21 March with the deadline printed on it.

I am stuck on this and need it done before close of business today.

Best regards,
Hiroshi Jansen

tickets.subject: Possible unauthorised access to my login
tickets.body:
Hi there,

There is an active session from a country I have never been to, so please revoke every session and force a password reset. The unfamiliar session appeared at 02:10 and is still listed as active. This cannot wait even a few hours; it is actively causing harm.

Best regards,
Lena Reyes

tickets.subject: All api calls failing since this morning
tickets.body:
Hello support team,

All of our api requests are hitting a timeout or a 503 error, and production traffic is failing. The error rate went from zero to 100 per cent at 09:40 and has stayed there.

Please escalate this immediately -- every minute it continues makes it worse.

Thank you for your help,
Camille Osei

tickets.subject: Shipment appears stuck in transit
tickets.body:
Hi there,

Tracking on ORD-558717 has been stuck at the same depot since 5 November; please find out what has happened to the parcel. It was scanned out of the Cork depot and has not been scanned anywhere else. A reply within a couple of working days would be ideal.

Many thanks,
Kenji Brennan

tickets.subject: Erasure request deadline is tomorrow morning
tickets.body:
Good morning,

The erasure request I made under data protection law is nearly out of time; the deadline is tomorrow morning. If the deadline passes I will have no choice but to raise it with the regulator.

Please treat this as same-day: I cannot carry on until it is done.

Kind regards,
Hiroshi Dubois

tickets.subject: Press assets for a piece next month
tickets.body:
Hello support team,

I am a journalist putting together a roundup for the Meridian Post next month and would like your press kit and logo files. Nothing is on deadline; the piece is not scheduled until the new month. Nothing here is time sensitive; please treat it as background.

Thank you for your help,
Hiroshi Jansen

tickets.subject: Desktop client will not sync -- error REF-WE7UF
tickets.body:
Hello support team,

Sync on the desktop client fails immediately with error REF-WE7UF, so none of my work is going anywhere. I have restarted it, cleared the local cache and tried another machine; the same error comes back.

I am blocked until this is sorted and I need it resolved today.

Many thanks,
Owen Donnelly

tickets.subject: Recovery email is out of date
tickets.body:
Hi,

Could you change the recovery email on my login to anders.lindqvist@harborlight.example? The old one no longer exists. My password works fine, so nothing is broken at the moment. There is no rush at all on this one.

Grateful for any help you can give,
Anders Lindqvist

tickets.subject: Need invoice INV-36573 again for expenses
tickets.body:
Dear support team,

Please resend invoice INV-36573; our finance team needs it before they will process my expenses. The card payment of $2,771.38 cleared on 20 February; I only need the document itself.

This is not blocking me today, but I would like it sorted this week.

Best regards,
Beatriz Weber

tickets.subject: Quote for 32 seats
tickets.body:
Hi,

Could you send a written quote for 32 seats? Our procurement team needs it on paper before they will raise anything. This would be our first contract with you, starting in the new quarter. Sometime in the next few working days would be fine.

Kind regards,
Fatima Novak

tickets.subject: Need an answer from recruiting today
tickets.body:
Dear support team,

Another employer's offer lapses tonight, so I need recruiting to say today whether I am still a candidate. The interview rounds finished on 2 January and I have heard nothing since. I am asking for immediate help: the situation is live and still running.

Kind regards,
Nora Moreau

tickets.subject: Signed order form needed before end of day
tickets.body:
Hello support team,

Our procurement team needs the countersigned order form from you today to release the purchase order. The quote you sent for 20 seats is agreed; it is only the paperwork that is missing.

I need this resolved today; tomorrow is already too late for me.

Thank you for your help,
Aisha Novak

tickets.subject: Change to our delivery instructions
tickets.body:
Good morning,

Could you add a note to our delivery instructions so the courier leaves future parcels at reception rather than the loading bay? The parcel from ORD-915430 arrived fine, so nothing has gone wrong; this is only about where things are left. Next week would be completely fine for a reply.

Grateful for any help you can give,
Zara Nakamura

tickets.subject: I have been sent another customer's personal data
tickets.body:
Hello,

I have just been sent someone else's personal data by mistake and need to know what to do with it. It lists names, home addresses and phone numbers for about forty people. This is happening right now and getting worse by the hour, so I need someone on it immediately.

Kind regards,
Noah Petrov

tickets.subject: Any update on my application?
tickets.body:
Good morning,

Could recruiting let me know whether my application for the data analyst position is still live? I applied three weeks ago. The reference I was given is REF-NTXWB and the date was 20 January. No emergency, but I would rather it did not sit for weeks.

Kind regards,
Lena Weber

tickets.subject: New phone, need two-factor set up again
tickets.body:
Good morning,

My authenticator codes are stuck on my old phone; please re-enrol two-factor on the new one. I am still signed in on my desktop, so I am not locked out while we sort this. This is not blocking me today, but I would like it sorted this week.

Thank you for your help,
Nora Kowalski

tickets.subject: Card payment failing on invoice INV-37910
tickets.body:
Dear support team,

Our card payment was declined this morning and the subscription lapses today, so please retry the charge on the replacement card. The failed amount is $1,754.21 against invoice INV-37910, and the new card is already on file. I am stuck on this and need it done before close of business today.

Thank you for your help,
Fatima Petrov

tickets.subject: Press fact-check, filing today
tickets.body:
Hi there,

I am fact-checking a figure for a piece in Foundry Quarterly that files to my editor at the end of the day and I need it confirmed before then. The number in question is $1,206.56, from a source I would like you to confirm.

I need this resolved today; tomorrow is already too late for me.

Best regards,
Kofi Kaur

tickets.subject: Cosmetic bug in the dashboard charts
tickets.body:
Hello,

I wanted to report a cosmetic bug -- the labels on the dashboard charts sit on top of one another at narrow widths. No error appears and nothing is broken; the numbers themselves are right.

This is not blocking anything, so whenever someone has time is fine.

Thank you for your help,
Beatriz Weber

tickets.subject: Publishing in two hours, statement needed
tickets.body:
Hello support team,

My editor publishes in two hours and I need your comment on the record before then. I have sent the relevant lines to your general inbox twice already today.

This cannot wait even a few hours; it is actively causing harm.

Thank you for your help,
Rafael Donnelly

tickets.subject: Missing delivery for an event tomorrow morning
tickets.body:
Hello,

ORD-605576 has not been delivered to the venue and we open tomorrow morning, so please trace the shipment now. Tracking shows the shipment back at the Bristol depot after a failed delivery attempt. This cannot wait even a few hours; it is actively causing harm.

Thank you for your help,
Mireille Mensah

tickets.subject: Keeping my cv on file for future openings
tickets.body:
Good morning,

I could not find a job on your careers page that fits, and wondered whether you keep a cv on file for future positions. I have eight years behind me as a backend engineer and would be glad to hear about anything similar. Next week would be completely fine for a reply.

Thanks in advance,
Aisha Marchetti

tickets.subject: Roadmap question while we evaluate
tickets.body:
Hi,

We are still evaluating vendors and would like to know whether a Spanish interface is planned before we choose one. We have no contract with you at the moment; this is groundwork for an autumn decision. Nothing here is time sensitive; please treat it as background.

Thanks in advance,
Maya Marchetti

tickets.subject: Billing address change for future invoices
tickets.body:
Hello,

Could you update the billing address we hold so that future invoices go to our new office? Invoice INV-76346 still shows the previous office, and we would like our cost centre code shown as well. Next week would be completely fine for a reply.

Many thanks,
Anja Sorensen

tickets.subject: Locked out after too many attempts
tickets.body:
Hi there,

Too many wrong password attempts have locked me out and I cannot get back in. The unlock link in your email takes me back to the same locked screen.

Please treat this as same-day: I cannot carry on until it is done.

Best regards,
Priya Vargas

tickets.subject: Formal data request under data protection law
tickets.body:
Hello,

Please treat this as a formal data request: I would like a copy of all the personal data you hold about me. Please confirm you have received this so the statutory period is on record.

Normal turnaround is fine, as long as it is dealt with this week.

Best regards,
Tomas Tanaka

tickets.subject: CSV export drops the last row
tickets.body:
Hi there,

The CSV export is dropping the last row of every report, which looks like an off-by-one bug. The api returns the row, so the problem is in the file itself.

Normal turnaround is fine, as long as it is dealt with this week.

Thank you for your help,
Maya Kowalski

tickets.subject: api returning 503 for every request
tickets.body:
Good morning,

The api is returning 503 on every endpoint and our live integration has stopped working entirely. Our monitoring shows the errors started at 09:40 and the error rate is still 100 per cent.

Please escalate this immediately -- every minute it continues makes it worse.

Grateful for any help you can give,
Tomas Kaur

tickets.subject: Purchase order window closing today
tickets.body:
Dear support team,

Our vendor portal shuts in three hours; without your countersigned contract uploaded, the purchase order is cancelled for the year. Our side is signed, so the 108 seat deal fails on this one document. This is happening right now and getting worse by the hour, so I need someone on it immediately.

Many thanks,
Jonas Halloran

tickets.subject: Need to move tomorrow's interview
tickets.body:
Hello support team,

Tomorrow's interview clashes with something I cannot move; can recruiting rebook it and confirm today? I can do any time later in the week. My reference is REF-JM9TY. I am stuck on this and need it done before close of business today.

Grateful for any help you can give,
Jonas Fischer

tickets.subject: Charged three times for invoice INV-77412
tickets.body:
Hello,

Three identical charges of $1,259.62 have come off the card against invoice INV-77412; please reverse the duplicates. Two of the charges have cleared and a third is pending, which has taken us past our overdraft limit.

This is happening right now and getting worse by the hour, so I need someone on it immediately.

Thank you for your help,
Anja Rossi

t060.instructions: Ticket 60: which department should handle it?

tickets.subject: Copy of invoice INV-36664
tickets.body:
Dear support team,

Could you send me another copy of invoice INV-36664? I need it for an expenses claim. The card payment of $213.41 cleared on 4 June; I only need the document itself. Normal turnaround is fine, as long as it is dealt with this week.

Grateful for any help you can give,
Ingrid Iqbal

tickets.subject: Request for a background conversation
tickets.body:
Good morning,

I am a reporter at the Meridian Post working on a feature and would like a background briefing, with something on the record afterwards. Publication is at the end of the month, so any slot in the next fortnight works. A reply within a couple of working days would be ideal.

Many thanks,
Noah Adeyemi

tickets.subject: Changing the recovery email on my login
tickets.body:
Hello,

I would like the recovery email for my login changed to rukmini.halloran@verdant.example. My password and authenticator both still work; I only want the recovery email corrected. I am only asking so I can plan ahead, so please take your time.

Best regards,
Rukmini Halloran

tickets.subject: Keeping my cv on file for future openings
tickets.body:
Dear support team,

Nothing on your job listings suits me right now; may I send my cv in for future openings anyway? I have spent the last eight years working as a product designer. Next week would be completely fine for a reply.

Thank you for your help,
Aisha Halloran

tickets.subject: Sync failing all morning with an error
tickets.body:
Hi,

Every sync attempt on the desktop client ends in error REF-BHTZP and nothing uploads. I have restarted it, cleared the local cache and tried another machine; the same error comes back.

I am blocked until this is sorted and I need it resolved today.

Thank you for your help,
Mateo Osei

tickets.subject: Retention question about personal data
tickets.body:
Hi there,

I am drafting a retention policy and would like to know your retention period for the personal data held in support conversations. Nothing needs to be deleted or produced; the policy itself is all I need.

There is no rush at all on this one.

Thank you for your help,
Diego Petrov

tickets.subject: Missing delivery for an event tomorrow morning
tickets.body:
Dear support team,

The shipment for ORD-418945 was due at the venue yesterday and is not here; the event opens tomorrow morning and we need the parcels found. Tracking shows the shipment back at the Adelaide depot after a failed delivery attempt. Please escalate this immediately -- every minute it continues makes it worse.

Thank you for your help,
Jonas Mensah

tickets.subject: Purchase order window closing today
tickets.body:
Dear support team,

Our vendor portal shuts in three hours; without your countersigned contract uploaded, the purchase order is cancelled for the year. Everything else for the 22 seat contract is ready; only your signature is missing. Please escalate this immediately -- every minute it continues makes it worse.

Many thanks,
Priya Bauer

tickets.subject: Redirect needed on ORD-999099
tickets.body:
Hi,

The parcel for ORD-999099 is on the van for the wrong address; please redirect the delivery before the courier arrives. The courier's page says delivery is expected within the hour. I am stuck on this and need it done before close of business today.

Thank you for your help,
Nora Ferreira

tickets.subject: Logo and press kit request
tickets.body:
Hello,

I am a journalist putting together a roundup for Circuit Weekly next month and would like your press kit and logo files. There is no deadline pressure here, since publication is weeks away. I am only asking so I can plan ahead, so please take your time.

Grateful for any help you can give,
Noah Kaur

tickets.subject: Card payment failing on invoice INV-79933
tickets.body:
Hi there,

Our card payment was declined this morning and the subscription lapses today, so please retry the charge on the replacement card. The replacement card works everywhere else; the outstanding amount is $1,556.26 on invoice INV-79933.

I need this resolved today; tomorrow is already too late for me.

Many thanks,
Camille Reyes

tickets.subject: Roadmap question while we evaluate
tickets.body:
Dear support team,

Before we go ahead and buy, could you tell me whether a Spanish interface is on the roadmap? We are still evaluating. We are not a customer yet; this is for a decision we will take in the autumn.

Nothing here is time sensitive; please treat it as background.

Kind regards,
Samuel Bauer

tickets.subject: Moving my authenticator to a new phone
tickets.body:
Dear support team,

I have a new phone and need my two-factor authenticator enrolled on it again. My desktop session is still active, so nothing is blocked in the meantime.

Normal turnaround is fine, as long as it is dealt with this week.

Many thanks,
Anja Weber

tickets.subject: CSV export drops the last row
tickets.body:
Dear support team,

The CSV export is dropping the last row of every report, which looks like an off-by-one bug. The api returns the row, so the problem is in the file itself.

A reply within a couple of working days would be ideal.

Thanks in advance,
Mateo Ferreira

tickets.subject: Need an answer from recruiting today
tickets.body:
Good morning,

Another employer's offer lapses tonight, so I need recruiting to say today whether I am still a candidate. I finished the last interview on 3 August; the reference is REF-5XYDR. We need someone on this within the hour; it is an emergency at our end.

Best regards,
Maya Tanaka

tickets.subject: Data protection incident: wrong attachment
tickets.body:
Hello support team,

I have just been sent someone else's personal data by mistake and need to know what to do with it. The file has names and home addresses for dozens of people who are not me. Please escalate this immediately -- every minute it continues makes it worse.

Thank you for your help,
Anja Haddad

tickets.subject: Locked out after too many attempts
tickets.body:
Hi,

Too many wrong password attempts have locked me out and I cannot get back in. The unlock link in your email takes me back to the same locked screen.

I need this resolved today; tomorrow is already too late for me.

Thank you for your help,
Sinead Novak

tickets.subject: Billing address change for future invoices
tickets.body:
Hello support team,

Please change the billing address on our invoices to our new office. Invoice INV-32634 still shows the previous office, and we would like our cost centre code shown as well. Next week would be completely fine for a reply.

Kind regards,
Owen Tanaka

tickets.subject: Order form needed today for procurement
tickets.body:
Hi there,

Our procurement team needs the countersigned order form from you today to release the purchase order. Everything in the quote for 49 seats is agreed internally and only your signature is outstanding.

I need this resolved today; tomorrow is already too late for me.

Grateful for any help you can give,
Elif Alvarez

tickets.subject: Status of my application for the support specialist position
tickets.body:
Hi there,

Three weeks after applying for the support specialist job I still have no news, so I wanted to ask whether my application is still being considered. The reference I was given is REF-GP64C and the date was 20 July. This is not blocking me today, but I would like it sorted this week.

Thank you for your help,
Noah Iqbal

tickets.subject: Checking a figure before we publish
tickets.body:
Hello,

I am fact-checking a figure for a piece in Foundry Quarterly that files to my editor at the end of the day and I need it confirmed before then. The number in question is $3,725.75, from a source I would like you to confirm.

Please treat this as same-day: I cannot carry on until it is done.

Kind regards,
Kofi Novak

tickets.subject: Formal data request under data protection law
tickets.body:
Hello,

Under data protection law I am asking for a copy of all personal data you hold on me. I understand you have a month to answer; I would just like to know it has arrived. A reply within a couple of working days would be ideal.

Thank you for your help,
Nora Novak

tickets.subject: Small display bug on the reports screen
tickets.body:
Dear support team,

I wanted to report a cosmetic bug -- the labels on the dashboard charts sit on top of one another at narrow widths. There is no error message and the underlying figures are correct.

This is not blocking anything, so whenever someone has time is fine.

Thanks in advance,
Anders Okafor

tickets.subject: Change to our delivery instructions
tickets.body:
Hello,

Please update the delivery instructions so parcels are handed in at reception instead of left at the loading bay. Nothing is missing from ORD-522275; it is only the drop-off point I would like changed. I am only asking so I can plan ahead, so please take your time.

Thank you for your help,
Rukmini Moreau

tickets.subject: Interview tomorrow -- can we reschedule?
tickets.body:
Hi there,

Tomorrow's interview clashes with something I cannot move; can recruiting rebook it and confirm today? Any slot later in the week works for me; the reference is REF-QHFEC. I am blocked until this is sorted and I need it resolved today.

Thank you for your help,
Hiroshi Bauer

tickets.subject: Charged three times for invoice INV-41083
tickets.body:
Dear support team,

The card has been charged $173.69 three times for invoice INV-41083 and a fourth payment attempt is pending. The duplicated payments have left us short for payroll this week. I am asking for immediate help: the situation is live and still running.

Grateful for any help you can give,
Sinead Osei

tickets.subject: Publishing in two hours, statement needed
tickets.body:
Hello support team,

The story runs in two hours and I have to carry either your statement or a line saying you declined. The piece names your company, so I would rather have your words in it than a note that you did not reply.

We need someone on this within the hour; it is an emergency at our end.

Thank you for your help,
Sinead Silva

tickets.subject: Written quote needed for procurement
tickets.body:
Hi,

Could you send a written quote for 97 seats? Our procurement team needs it on paper before they will raise anything. We have never bought from you before, so there is nothing on record at your end. Normal turnaround is fine, as long as it is dealt with this week.

Many thanks,
Anja Jansen

tickets.subject: Shipment appears stuck in transit
tickets.body:
Hi there,

Tracking on ORD-670043 has been stuck at the same depot since 9 March; please find out what has happened to the parcel. The last scan was at the Bristol depot and there has been no movement at all. Normal turnaround is fine, as long as it is dealt with this week.

Kind regards,
Noah Halloran

tickets.subject: Erasure request deadline is tomorrow morning
tickets.body:
Hello,

The erasure request I made under data protection law is nearly out of time; the deadline is tomorrow morning. I still have the acknowledgement you sent on 21 March with the deadline printed on it.

I am stuck on this and need it done before close of business today.

Best regards,
Hiroshi Jansen

tickets.subject: Possible unauthorised access to my login
tickets.body:
Hi there,

There is an active session from a country I have never been to, so please revoke every session and force a password reset. The unfamiliar session appeared at 02:10 and is still listed as active. This cannot wait even a few hours; it is actively causing harm.

Best regards,
Lena Reyes

tickets.subject: All api calls failing since this morning
tickets.body:
Hello support team,

All of our api requests are hitting a timeout or a 503 error, and production traffic is failing. The error rate went from zero to 100 per cent at 09:40 and has stayed there.

Please escalate this immediately -- every minute it continues makes it worse.

Thank you for your help,
Camille Osei

tickets.subject: Shipment appears stuck in transit
tickets.body:
Hi there,

Tracking on ORD-558717 has been stuck at the same depot since 5 November; please find out what has happened to the parcel. It was scanned out of the Cork depot and has not been scanned anywhere else. A reply within a couple of working days would be ideal.

Many thanks,
Kenji Brennan

tickets.subject: Erasure request deadline is tomorrow morning
tickets.body:
Good morning,

The erasure request I made under data protection law is nearly out of time; the deadline is tomorrow morning. If the deadline passes I will have no choice but to raise it with the regulator.

Please treat this as same-day: I cannot carry on until it is done.

Kind regards,
Hiroshi Dubois

tickets.subject: Press assets for a piece next month
tickets.body:
Hello support team,

I am a journalist putting together a roundup for the Meridian Post next month and would like your press kit and logo files. Nothing is on deadline; the piece is not scheduled until the new month. Nothing here is time sensitive; please treat it as background.

Thank you for your help,
Hiroshi Jansen

tickets.subject: Desktop client will not sync -- error REF-WE7UF
tickets.body:
Hello support team,

Sync on the desktop client fails immediately with error REF-WE7UF, so none of my work is going anywhere. I have restarted it, cleared the local cache and tried another machine; the same error comes back.

I am blocked until this is sorted and I need it resolved today.

Many thanks,
Owen Donnelly

tickets.subject: Recovery email is out of date
tickets.body:
Hi,

Could you change the recovery email on my login to anders.lindqvist@harborlight.example? The old one no longer exists. My password works fine, so nothing is broken at the moment. There is no rush at all on this one.

Grateful for any help you can give,
Anders Lindqvist

tickets.subject: Need invoice INV-36573 again for expenses
tickets.body:
Dear support team,

Please resend invoice INV-36573; our finance team needs it before they will process my expenses. The card payment of $2,771.38 cleared on 20 February; I only need the document itself.

This is not blocking me today, but I would like it sorted this week.

Best regards,
Beatriz Weber

tickets.subject: Quote for 32 seats
tickets.body:
Hi,

Could you send a written quote for 32 seats? Our procurement team needs it on paper before they will raise anything. This would be our first contract with you, starting in the new quarter. Sometime in the next few working days would be fine.

Kind regards,
Fatima Novak

tickets.subject: Need an answer from recruiting today
tickets.body:
Dear support team,

Another employer's offer lapses tonight, so I need recruiting to say today whether I am still a candidate. The interview rounds finished on 2 January and I have heard nothing since. I am asking for immediate help: the situation is live and still running.

Kind regards,
Nora Moreau

tickets.subject: Signed order form needed before end of day
tickets.body:
Hello support team,

Our procurement team needs the countersigned order form from you today to release the purchase order. The quote you sent for 20 seats is agreed; it is only the paperwork that is missing.

I need this resolved today; tomorrow is already too late for me.

Thank you for your help,
Aisha Novak

tickets.subject: Change to our delivery instructions
tickets.body:
Good morning,

Could you add a note to our delivery instructions so the courier leaves future parcels at reception rather than the loading bay? The parcel from ORD-915430 arrived fine, so nothing has gone wrong; this is only about where things are left. Next week would be completely fine for a reply.

Grateful for any help you can give,
Zara Nakamura

tickets.subject: I have been sent another customer's personal data
tickets.body:
Hello,

I have just been sent someone else's personal data by mistake and need to know what to do with it. It lists names, home addresses and phone numbers for about forty people. This is happening right now and getting worse by the hour, so I need someone on it immediately.

Kind regards,
Noah Petrov

tickets.subject: Any update on my application?
tickets.body:
Good morning,

Could recruiting let me know whether my application for the data analyst position is still live? I applied three weeks ago. The reference I was given is REF-NTXWB and the date was 20 January. No emergency, but I would rather it did not sit for weeks.

Kind regards,
Lena Weber

tickets.subject: New phone, need two-factor set up again
tickets.body:
Good morning,

My authenticator codes are stuck on my old phone; please re-enrol two-factor on the new one. I am still signed in on my desktop, so I am not locked out while we sort this. This is not blocking me today, but I would like it sorted this week.

Thank you for your help,
Nora Kowalski

tickets.subject: Card payment failing on invoice INV-37910
tickets.body:
Dear support team,

Our card payment was declined this morning and the subscription lapses today, so please retry the charge on the replacement card. The failed amount is $1,754.21 against invoice INV-37910, and the new card is already on file. I am stuck on this and need it done before close of business today.

Thank you for your help,
Fatima Petrov

tickets.subject: Press fact-check, filing today
tickets.body:
Hi there,

I am fact-checking a figure for a piece in Foundry Quarterly that files to my editor at the end of the day and I need it confirmed before then. The number in question is $1,206.56, from a source I would like you to confirm.

I need this resolved today; tomorrow is already too late for me.

Best regards,
Kofi Kaur

tickets.subject: Cosmetic bug in the dashboard charts
tickets.body:
Hello,

I wanted to report a cosmetic bug -- the labels on the dashboard charts sit on top of one another at narrow widths. No error appears and nothing is broken; the numbers themselves are right.

This is not blocking anything, so whenever someone has time is fine.

Thank you for your help,
Beatriz Weber

tickets.subject: Publishing in two hours, statement needed
tickets.body:
Hello support team,

My editor publishes in two hours and I need your comment on the record before then. I have sent the relevant lines to your general inbox twice already today.

This cannot wait even a few hours; it is actively causing harm.

Thank you for your help,
Rafael Donnelly

tickets.subject: Missing delivery for an event tomorrow morning
tickets.body:
Hello,

ORD-605576 has not been delivered to the venue and we open tomorrow morning, so please trace the shipment now. Tracking shows the shipment back at the Bristol depot after a failed delivery attempt. This cannot wait even a few hours; it is actively causing harm.

Thank you for your help,
Mireille Mensah

tickets.subject: Keeping my cv on file for future openings
tickets.body:
Good morning,

I could not find a job on your careers page that fits, and wondered whether you keep a cv on file for future positions. I have eight years behind me as a backend engineer and would be glad to hear about anything similar. Next week would be completely fine for a reply.

Thanks in advance,
Aisha Marchetti

tickets.subject: Roadmap question while we evaluate
tickets.body:
Hi,

We are still evaluating vendors and would like to know whether a Spanish interface is planned before we choose one. We have no contract with you at the moment; this is groundwork for an autumn decision. Nothing here is time sensitive; please treat it as background.

Thanks in advance,
Maya Marchetti

tickets.subject: Billing address change for future invoices
tickets.body:
Hello,

Could you update the billing address we hold so that future invoices go to our new office? Invoice INV-76346 still shows the previous office, and we would like our cost centre code shown as well. Next week would be completely fine for a reply.

Many thanks,
Anja Sorensen

tickets.subject: Locked out after too many attempts
tickets.body:
Hi there,

Too many wrong password attempts have locked me out and I cannot get back in. The unlock link in your email takes me back to the same locked screen.

Please treat this as same-day: I cannot carry on until it is done.

Best regards,
Priya Vargas

tickets.subject: Formal data request under data protection law
tickets.body:
Hello,

Please treat this as a formal data request: I would like a copy of all the personal data you hold about me. Please confirm you have received this so the statutory period is on record.

Normal turnaround is fine, as long as it is dealt with this week.

Best regards,
Tomas Tanaka

tickets.subject: CSV export drops the last row
tickets.body:
Hi there,

The CSV export is dropping the last row of every report, which looks like an off-by-one bug. The api returns the row, so the problem is in the file itself.

Normal turnaround is fine, as long as it is dealt with this week.

Thank you for your help,
Maya Kowalski

tickets.subject: api returning 503 for every request
tickets.body:
Good morning,

The api is returning 503 on every endpoint and our live integration has stopped working entirely. Our monitoring shows the errors started at 09:40 and the error rate is still 100 per cent.

Please escalate this immediately -- every minute it continues makes it worse.

Grateful for any help you can give,
Tomas Kaur

tickets.subject: Purchase order window closing today
tickets.body:
Dear support team,

Our vendor portal shuts in three hours; without your countersigned contract uploaded, the purchase order is cancelled for the year. Our side is signed, so the 108 seat deal fails on this one document. This is happening right now and getting worse by the hour, so I need someone on it immediately.

Many thanks,
Jonas Halloran

tickets.subject: Need to move tomorrow's interview
tickets.body:
Hello support team,

Tomorrow's interview clashes with something I cannot move; can recruiting rebook it and confirm today? I can do any time later in the week. My reference is REF-JM9TY. I am stuck on this and need it done before close of business today.

Grateful for any help you can give,
Jonas Fischer

tickets.subject: Charged three times for invoice INV-77412
tickets.body:
Hello,

Three identical charges of $1,259.62 have come off the card against invoice INV-77412; please reverse the duplicates. Two of the charges have cleared and a third is pending, which has taken us past our overdraft limit.

This is happening right now and getting worse by the hour, so I need someone on it immediately.

Thank you for your help,
Anja Rossi

Kind regards,
Mireille Weber

Best regards,
Rafael Okafor

Grateful for any help you can give,
Hiroshi Novak

Hello support team,

No emergency, but I would rather it did not sit for weeks.

Kind regards,
Maya Weber

Best regards,
Noah Nakamura

No emergency, but I would rather it did not sit for weeks.

Thank you for your help,

Best regards,
Beatriz Kaur

Grateful for any help you can give,
Camille Osei

No emergency, but I would rather it did not sit for weeks.

Many thanks,
Mireille Fischer

tickets.body:

Kind regards,
Maya Bauer

Hello,

Kind regards,
Beatriz Alvarez

tickets.subject: Recovery email is out of date
tickets.body:
Good morning,

Could you change the recovery email on my login to mireille.weber@ostara.example? The old one no longer exists. My password works fine, so nothing is broken at the moment. Next week would be completely fine for a reply.

Kind regards,
Mireille Weber

tickets.subject: Signed order form needed before end of day
tickets.body:
Good morning,

Our procurement team needs the countersigned order form from you today to release the purchase order. The 47 seat quote is approved on our side and nothing else is holding it up. Please treat this as same-day: I cannot carry on until it is done.

Best regards,
Rafael Okafor

tickets.subject: Updating the billing details on our invoices
tickets.body:
Hello,

I would like the billing address printed on our invoices changed to the new office. The old one is still shown on invoice INV-26345, and we would like our cost centre code added while you are in there. This is not blocking anything, so whenever someone has time is fine.

Grateful for any help you can give,
Hiroshi Novak

tickets.subject: Any update on my application?
tickets.body:
Hello support team,

Three weeks after applying for the support specialist job I still have no news, so I wanted to ask whether my application is still being considered. The reference I was given is REF-74J3T and the date was 11 June.

No emergency, but I would rather it did not sit for weeks.

Kind regards,
Maya Weber

tickets.subject: Data protection deadline on my erasure request
tickets.body:
Good morning,

I made an erasure request a month ago and have heard nothing; the statutory deadline falls tomorrow morning. I still have the acknowledgement you sent on 17 July with the deadline printed on it. I am stuck on this and need it done before close of business today.

Best regards,
Noah Nakamura

tickets.subject: Written quote needed for procurement
tickets.body:
Hi,

Please send pricing for 103 seats as a written quote; procurement will not move without one. This would be our first contract with you, starting in the new quarter. No emergency, but I would rather it did not sit for weeks.

Grateful for any help you can give,
Hiroshi Weber

tickets.subject: Decision deadline tonight on my application
tickets.body:
Hello,

Another employer's offer lapses tonight, so I need recruiting to say today whether I am still a candidate. I finished the last interview on 24 July; the reference is REF-8VTYG. This cannot wait even a few hours; it is actively causing harm.

Thank you for your help,
Priya Novak

tickets.subject: Two-factor re-enrolment needed
tickets.body:
Hello support team,

My authenticator codes are stuck on my old phone; please re-enrol two-factor on the new one. I still have a working session on my laptop and can wait for this to be done properly.

No emergency, but I would rather it did not sit for weeks.

Thank you for your help,
Priya Jansen

tickets.subject: Production integration is down with api errors
tickets.body:
Hi,

All of our api requests are hitting a timeout or a 503 error, and production traffic is failing. Our retries fail too; the stack trace is the same timeout every time.

I am asking for immediate help: the situation is live and still running.

Best regards,
Beatriz Kaur

tickets.subject: Charged three times for invoice INV-55821
tickets.body:
Good morning,

We have been charged $4,533.47 three times for invoice INV-55821 and the payments are still going out, so please stop them and refund the duplicates. The duplicated payments have left us short for payroll this week. Please escalate this immediately -- every minute it continues makes it worse.

Grateful for any help you can give,
Camille Osei

tickets.subject: Story runs at 17:00 and needs your comment
tickets.body:
Hi,

We are publishing a story about your company in two hours and I need a statement from you before it goes out. The piece names your company, so I would rather have your words in it than a note that you did not reply. I am asking for immediate help: the situation is live and still running.

Thanks in advance,
Mateo Brennan

tickets.subject: Data subject access request
tickets.body:
Hi there,

Please treat this as a formal data request: I would like a copy of all the personal data you hold about me. A note back to say it has arrived would be helpful so that both of us have the date written down.

No emergency, but I would rather it did not sit for weeks.

Many thanks,
Mireille Fischer

tickets.subject: Delivery is heading to the wrong address
tickets.body:
Dear support team,

The parcel for ORD-640323 is on the van for the wrong address; please redirect the delivery before the courier arrives. The courier's page says delivery is expected within the hour. I am stuck on this and need it done before close of business today.

Thanks in advance,
Sven Brennan

tickets.subject: Possible unauthorised access to my login

Best regards,
Hiroshi Petrov

tickets.subject: Media kit request for a roundup
tickets.body:
Hi,

Grateful for any help you can give,
Nora Brennan

Dear support team,

Could you tell me how long you keep the personal data in support conversations? I am writing our own retention policy and want to line it up with yours. Thank you for your help,
Tomas Bauer

Best regards,
Hiroshi Dubois

Hiroshi Haddad

Zara Mensah

tickets.body:

Maya Tanaka

tickets.subject: Parcel going to our old address today

I am stuck on this and need it done before close of business today.

Best regards,
Beatriz Reyes

tickets.subject: Press request before publication this afternoon
tickets.body:
Dear support team,

The story runs in two hours and I have to carry either your statement or a line saying you declined. I tried your newsroom line twice this morning with no answer.

Please escalate this immediately -- every minute it continues makes it worse.

Thanks in advance,
Sven Mensah

Hello,

Three identical charges of $2,011.51 have come off the card against invoice INV-16278; please reverse the duplicates. Two of the charges have cleared and a third is pending, which has taken us past our overdraft limit.

This cannot wait even a few hours; it is actively causing harm.

Yusuf Bauer

tickets.subject: Two-factor re-enrolment needed

A reply within a couple of working days would be ideal.

Thanks in advance,
Ingrid Haddad

tickets.subject: ORD-608158 has not arrived and the event opens tomorrow
tickets.body:
Good morning,

We are missing the entire delivery for ORD-608158 at the venue and the event starts tomorrow. Tracking shows the shipment back at the Tallinn depot after a failed delivery attempt. We need someone on this within the hour; it is an emergency at our end.

Many thanks,
Sven Brennan

tickets.subject: Written quote needed for procurement
tickets.body:
Dear support team,

We need a formal quote for 62 seats so that procurement can raise the purchase order. We would be a new customer and the budget is approved for the new quarter.

This is not blocking me today, but I would like it sorted this week.

Grateful for any help you can give,
Kenji Kowalski

tickets.subject: Sync error is stopping me working
tickets.body:
Hi,

Every sync attempt on the desktop client ends in error REF-2FY95 and nothing uploads. I have restarted it, cleared the local cache and tried another machine; the same error comes back. I am blocked until this is sorted and I need it resolved today.

Kind regards,
Sinead Nakamura

tickets.subject: Cannot log in -- locked out
tickets.body:
Hi,

My login is locked after several failed attempts and the password reset link does nothing. Changing the password does not clear the lock; I end up at the same screen.

I need this resolved today; tomorrow is already too late for me.

Best regards,
Owen Okafor

tickets.subject: No suitable job right now, but for the future
tickets.body:
Hello support team,

There is no position open that fits me at the moment, so could you keep my cv on file for future openings? I have spent the last eight years working as a product designer.

This is not blocking anything, so whenever someone has time is fine.

Thanks in advance,
Sven Ferreira

tickets.subject: I have been sent another customer's personal data
tickets.body:

This is happening right now and getting worse by the hour, so I need someone on it immediately.

Thanks in advance,
Diego Tanaka

tickets.subject: Press fact-check, filing today
tickets.body:
Hi,

My editor takes the copy at the end of today and I need one number confirmed on the record before I file. The figure I have is $599.27 and I would rather print it right than print it fast.

I am stuck on this and need it done before close of business today.

Best regards,
Lena Alvarez

tickets.subject: Copy of invoice INV-52480
tickets.body:
Hi there,

Could you send me another copy of invoice INV-52480? I need it for an expenses claim. It was charged to the card on 18 January for $1,746.89, so nothing is outstanding.

Normal turnaround is fine, as long as it is dealt with this week.

Best regards,
Samuel Mensah

tickets.subject: Request for a background conversation
tickets.body:
Dear support team,

I am a reporter at Northgate Review working on a feature and would like a background briefing, with something on the record afterwards. The piece is scheduled for the end of the month, so there is time to arrange it properly. Normal turnaround is fine, as long as it is dealt with this week.

Grateful for any help you can give,
Hiroshi Silva

tickets.subject: Shipment appears stuck in transit
tickets.body:
Hi there,

Could you chase the courier about ORD-622080? The tracking has shown the same depot since 26 October. It was scanned out of the Nairobi depot and has not been scanned anywhere else. A reply within a couple of working days would be ideal.

Kind regards,
Beatriz Petrov

tickets.subject: Interview tomorrow -- can we reschedule?
tickets.body:
Hello support team,

Tomorrow's interview clashes with something I cannot move; can recruiting rebook it and confirm today? Later in the week is wide open for me and my reference is REF-TWFPH. I am blocked until this is sorted and I need it resolved today.

Many thanks,
Rukmini Bauer

Best regards,
Fatima Iqbal

tickets.subject: Billing address change for future invoices
tickets.body:
Hi there,

Could you update the billing address we hold so that future invoices go to our new office? The old one is still shown on invoice INV-45553, and we would like our cost centre code added while you are in there.

Next week would be completely fine for a reply.

Grateful for any help you can give,
Diego Iqbal

tickets.subject: Any update on my application?
tickets.body:
Good morning,

I applied for the site reliability engineer position three weeks ago and have heard nothing; could someone in recruiting tell me where my application stands? I applied on 11 May and the reference given was REF-2D8U3. This is not blocking me today, but I would like it sorted this week.

Many thanks,
Rukmini Adeyemi

tickets.subject: Shipment for tomorrow's event is not at the venue
tickets.body:
Hi,

ORD-108210 has not been delivered to the venue and we open tomorrow morning, so please trace the shipment now. The courier's line says the pallet is sitting at the Montpellier depot with no driver assigned. I am asking for immediate help: the situation is live and still running.

Kind regards,
Ingrid Lindqvist

tickets.subject: Sync error is stopping me working
tickets.body:
Hi there,

Sync on the desktop client fails immediately with error REF-9YGGR, so none of my work is going anywhere. The log file shows the same timeout each time before the error appears. This is stopping me from working right now, so it has to be fixed before the end of the day.

Grateful for any help you can give,
Noah Marchetti

tickets.subject: Quote for 48 seats
tickets.body:
Good morning,

Please send pricing for 48 seats as a written quote; procurement will not move without one. We would be a new customer and the budget is approved for the new quarter. This is not blocking me today, but I would like it sorted this week.

Grateful for any help you can give,
Owen Sorensen

tickets.subject: How long do you keep support transcripts?
tickets.body:
Hello support team,

For our own records, what is your retention period for the personal data in support conversations? I am not asking you to do anything with my data, only to describe the policy.

This is not blocking anything, so whenever someone has time is fine.

Many thanks,
Ingrid Sorensen

tickets.subject: Locked out after too many attempts
tickets.body:
Hi there,

My login is locked after several failed attempts and the password reset link does nothing. I have waited the thirty minutes it suggests and the lock is still there. Please treat this as same-day: I cannot carry on until it is done.

Many thanks,
Kofi Nakamura

tickets.subject: api returning 503 for every request
tickets.body:
Hello,

The api is returning 503 on every endpoint and our live integration has stopped working entirely. The error rate went from zero to 100 per cent at 09:40 and has stayed there. We need someone on this within the hour; it is an emergency at our end.

Grateful for any help you can give,
Kofi Rossi

tickets.subject: Press request: feature in the Weekly Ledger
tickets.body:
Hello,

I write for the Weekly Ledger and would like to set up a background briefing with someone from your team. My editor has it down for the end of the month.

A reply within a couple of working days would be ideal.

Thanks in advance,
Tomas Haddad

tickets.subject: Interview tomorrow -- can we reschedule?
tickets.body:
Hello,

My interview is tomorrow morning and I have to move it, so could the recruiter confirm a new time today? I can do any time later in the week. My reference is REF-N69W7.

This is stopping me from working right now, so it has to be fixed before the end of the day.

Kind regards,
Fatima Okafor

tickets.subject: Roadmap question while we evaluate
tickets.body:
Hello support team,

Before we go ahead and buy, could you tell me whether a Spanish interface is on the roadmap? We are still evaluating. Nothing has been bought yet and the decision will not be made until the autumn.

Next week would be completely fine for a reply.

Many thanks,
Mireille Bauer

tickets.subject: Our card was declined and the subscription is at risk
tickets.body:
Good morning,

Our card payment was declined this morning and the subscription lapses today, so please retry the charge on the replacement card. The failed amount is $1,261.25 against invoice INV-56928, and the new card is already on file. I need this resolved today; tomorrow is already too late for me.

Thank you for your help,
Owen Brennan

tickets.subject: Tracking has not moved since 19 October
tickets.body:
Hi,

Could you chase the courier about ORD-217205? The tracking has shown the same depot since 19 October. The courier's page shows it left the Bristol depot and nothing since. Sometime in the next few working days would be fine.

Kind regards,
Samuel Jansen

tickets.subject: Delivery preference for future parcels
tickets.body:
Dear support team,

Please update the delivery instructions so parcels are handed in at reception instead of left at the loading bay. ORD-922866 was delivered without any problem; I am just trying to save the courier a walk next time. I am only asking so I can plan ahead, so please take your time.

Grateful for any help you can give,
Owen Marchetti

tickets.subject: Need an answer from recruiting today
tickets.body:
Hi,

My other offer expires tonight and I would rather join you, so can the recruiter tell me where my application stands before then? I finished the last interview on 26 March; the reference is REF-6D96E.

I am asking for immediate help: the situation is live and still running.

Kind regards,
Rukmini Lindqvist

tickets.subject: Press request before publication this afternoon
tickets.body:
Dear support team,

The story runs in two hours and I have to carry either your statement or a line saying you declined. I tried your newsroom line twice this morning with no answer.

We need someone on this within the hour; it is an emergency at our end.

Best regards,
Priya Alvarez

tickets.subject: Chart labels overlap in the dashboard
tickets.body:
Hello support team,

There is a small bug on the reports screen: the chart labels overlap each other once the window is narrow. There is no error message and the underlying figures are correct. There is no rush at all on this one.

Many thanks,
Nora Iqbal

Best regards,
Jonas Halloran

tickets.body:
Hi,

Rukmini Tanaka

Hi,

This is not blocking anything, so whenever someone has time is fine.

Kind regards,
Samuel Kaur

tickets.body:
Hi,

My other offer expires tonight and I would rather join you, so can the recruiter tell me where my application stands before then? I finished the last interview on 20 July; the reference is REF-PGCK5. Please escalate this immediately -- every minute it continues makes it worse.

Thanks in advance,
Aisha Mensah

Dear support team,

I am locked out after too many failed sign-in attempts and cannot log in at all. I have waited the thirty minutes it suggests and the lock is still there. I need this resolved today; tomorrow is already too late for me.

Best regards,
Noah Novak

tickets.body:
Hello,

I wanted to report a cosmetic bug -- the labels on the dashboard charts sit on top of one another at narrow widths. No error appears and nothing is broken; the numbers themselves are right.

I am only asking so I can plan ahead, so please take your time.

Many thanks,
Samuel Alvarez

tickets.subject: Order form needed today for procurement
tickets.body:
Hi,

Our procurement team needs the countersigned order form from you today to release the purchase order. The quote you sent for 26 seats is agreed; it is only the paperwork that is missing.

I am blocked until this is sorted and I need it resolved today.

Best regards,
Fatima Tanaka

Hello,

The parcel for ORD-866063 is on the van for the wrong address; please redirect the delivery before the courier arrives. Tracking shows the van a few streets from the old address. I need this resolved today; tomorrow is already too late for me.

Thank you for your help,
Lena Halloran

tickets.body:
Good morning,

I could not find a job on your careers page that fits, and wondered whether you keep a cv on file for future positions. My background is eight years as a backend engineer. Next week would be completely fine for a reply.

Grateful for any help you can give,
Lena Fischer

tickets.subject: Request for a copy of my personal data
tickets.body:
Hello,

Under data protection law I am asking for a copy of all personal data you hold on me. Please confirm you have received this so the statutory period is on record. A reply within a couple of working days would be ideal.

Grateful for any help you can give,
Ingrid Brennan

tickets.body:
Hi,

Please update the recovery email attached to my login to priya.nakamura@pinewell.example. My password works fine, so nothing is broken at the moment. This is not blocking anything, so whenever someone has time is fine.

Thank you for your help,
Priya Nakamura

tickets.body:
Hello,

Tracking on ORD-697604 has been stuck at the same depot since 22 October; please find out what has happened to the parcel. The courier's page shows it left the Nairobi depot and nothing since. No emergency, but I would rather it did not sit for weeks.

Thank you for your help,
Rukmini Ferreira

tickets.body:
Hi,

Sync on the desktop client fails immediately with error REF-CYYZP, so none of my work is going anywhere. The log file shows the same timeout each time before the error appears. This is stopping me from working right now, so it has to be fixed before the end of the day.

Best regards,
Samuel Bauer

tickets.subject: Billing address change for future invoices
tickets.body:
Hello support team,

Could you update the billing address we hold so that future invoices go to our new office? Everything else on invoice INV-34496 is correct; only the address and the cost centre code need changing. I am only asking so I can plan ahead, so please take your time.

Thanks in advance,
Priya Donnelly

tickets.subject: Pricing for 50 seats at Harborlight Group
tickets.body:
Hi,

Please send pricing for 50 seats as a written quote; procurement will not move without one. We would be a new customer and the budget is approved for the new quarter. Sometime in the next few working days would be fine.

Best regards,
Noah Kaur

tickets.subject: Publishing in two hours, statement needed
tickets.body:
Good morning,

The story runs in two hours and I have to carry either your statement or a line saying you declined. I tried your newsroom line twice this morning with no answer. I am asking for immediate help: the situation is live and still running.

Grateful for any help you can give,
Aisha Jansen

tickets.subject: Following up on my job application
tickets.body:
Hi,

Three weeks after applying for the data analyst job I still have no news, so I wanted to ask whether my application is still being considered. The reference on it is REF-ESD38, submitted on 19 March.

Normal turnaround is fine, as long as it is dealt with this week.

Kind regards,
Rafael Tanaka

tickets.body:

All of our api requests are hitting a timeout or a 503 error, and production traffic is failing. The error rate went from zero to 100 per cent at 09:40 and has stayed there.

Please escalate this immediately -- every minute it continues makes it worse.

Thanks in advance,
Zara Silva

tickets.body:
Hello,

I have a new phone and need my two-factor authenticator enrolled on it again. I am still signed in on my desktop, so I am not locked out while we sort this. Sometime in the next few working days would be fine.

Kind regards,
Kofi Moreau

Hello support team,

The message you sent me this morning has another customer's personal data attached to it, and the file is sitting in my inbox now. There are names, addresses and phone numbers for around forty individuals in it. Please escalate this immediately -- every minute it continues makes it worse.

Thank you for your help,
Tomas Bauer

tickets.body:
Good morning,

Could you send me another copy of invoice INV-91512? I need it for an expenses claim. The payment itself went through on 19 June for $417.48, so this is only about the paperwork.

This is not blocking me today, but I would like it sorted this week.

Kind regards,
Aisha Vargas

tickets.body:
Good morning,

Before we go ahead and buy, could you tell me whether a Spanish interface is on the roadmap? We are still evaluating. We are not a customer yet; this is for a decision we will take in the autumn. I am only asking so I can plan ahead, so please take your time.

Many thanks,
Jonas Reyes

Many thanks,
Sinead Iqbal

Many thanks,
Rafael Bauer

Grateful for any help you can give,
Kenji Mensah

Thanks in advance,
Diego Tanaka

Best regards,
Rafael Silva

Kind regards,
Hiroshi Bauer

Many thanks,
Mireille Bauer

tickets.subject: Our card was declined and the subscription is at risk
tickets.body:
Good morning,

Our card payment was declined this morning and the subscription lapses today, so please retry the charge on the replacement card. The failed amount is $1,261.25 against invoice INV-56928, and the new card is already on file. I need this resolved today; tomorrow is already too late for me.

Thank you for your help,
Owen Brennan

tickets.subject: Tracking has not moved since 19 October
tickets.body:
Hi,

Could you chase the courier about ORD-217205? The tracking has shown the same depot since 19 October. The courier's page shows it left the Bristol depot and nothing since. Sometime in the next few working days would be fine.

Kind regards,
Samuel Jansen

tickets.subject: Delivery preference for future parcels
tickets.body:
Dear support team,

Please update the delivery instructions so parcels are handed in at reception instead of left at the loading bay. ORD-922866 was delivered without any problem; I am just trying to save the courier a walk next time. I am only asking so I can plan ahead, so please take your time.

Grateful for any help you can give,
Owen Marchetti

tickets.subject: Need an answer from recruiting today
tickets.body:
Hi,

My other offer expires tonight and I would rather join you, so can the recruiter tell me where my application stands before then? I finished the last interview on 26 March; the reference is REF-6D96E.

I am asking for immediate help: the situation is live and still running.

Kind regards,
Rukmini Lindqvist

tickets.subject: Press request before publication this afternoon
tickets.body:
Dear support team,

The story runs in two hours and I have to carry either your statement or a line saying you declined. I tried your newsroom line twice this morning with no answer.

We need someone on this within the hour; it is an emergency at our end.

Best regards,
Priya Alvarez

tickets.subject: Chart labels overlap in the dashboard
tickets.body:
Hello support team,

There is a small bug on the reports screen: the chart labels overlap each other once the window is narrow. There is no error message and the underlying figures are correct. There is no rush at all on this one.

Many thanks,
Nora Iqbal
